usedFor: Tny shortens links with “Shorten URL” and follows a short link to its destination with “Unshorten URL”.

bestTemplate.name: “Shorten URL” in Tny
bestTemplate.why: It generates a shortened link from a long URL, so messages carry a clean address.

watchOut: “Unshorten URL” follows all redirects, so the final address may differ from the link you started with.
